newsitem.title: PERU: Telefonica lifts Lima bolsa to higher close.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica lifts Lima bolsa to higher close.

text.p: Bellwether stock Telefonica del Peru led share prices on the Lima Stock Exchange to close higher for the second successive session in moderate trading Friday, brokers said.
"Telefonica dragged the whole market higher," said Vanessa Chiesa of the Investa brokerage.
According to preliminary figures, the bolsa's General Index rose 0.90 percent to 1,679.84 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index was up 0.95 percent at 2,415.33 points.
Stocks were expected to continue broadly bullish next week with the market focused on first quarter results, brokers said.
"The fundamentals are positive. What could selectively hurt stocks in the coming days are the March balance sheets," said Lorenzo Wong, an analyst at Intercapital brokerage.
Turnover was 38 million soles ($14.3 million) on 1,775 trades. Of the 87 stocks traded, 35 rose, 21 fell and 31 closed unchanged.
Telefonica del Peru B shares rose 2.15 percent to 6.19 soles on 1,580,579 shares, while electric utility Edegel rose 6.61 percent to 1.29 soles on 973,605 shares.
Mining stocks closed mixed with Atacocha down 0.96 percent at 1.03 soles on 233,681 shares, and Morococha rising 2.26 percent to 2.26 soles on 124,575 shares.
